description: If the ground-term universe of \(L\) is nonempty, every set \(\Gamma\) of actual universally asserted equality-free relation clauses has no nonempty model exactly when the specified generalized first-order resolution calculus derives the empty clause from \(\Gamma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.refutational_completeness.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [Nonempty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L)]
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L ℕ)) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseSatisfiable Γ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.Derives Γ ∅
